named_subject: a paintbrush (pointed scribbled bristle head on a handle drawn as two lines)
action: The brush tip slides slowly down and to the left while the grey paint stroke behind it lengthens, then in the last frame the brush jumps back up and to the right.
identity_gap: The bristle scribble matches the doodle, but the doodle's handle is a long closed tapered outline while the animation shows only two open lines that run off the bottom of the frame.
notes: Frames 1 to 15 track the film's slow down-left drift closely, and the jump at frame 16 also happens in the film, though the film's blur/doubling at frame 15 is not shown. The change that would help most is drawing the handle as the doodle's closed outline, so the brush reads as the same drawing and not just its head.
